title: Options for playing from a penalty area
question: After your ball is found in a penalty area, what choices do you have about playing your next shot?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies inside the penalty area, with no extra penalty.
Take a drop outside the penalty area, with a one-stroke penalty.
Drop a second ball anywhere in the penalty area, without penalty.
You must return to the teeing area and replay the shot.

explanation: You may play the ball as it lies in the penalty area (with no extra penalty) or take penalty area relief by dropping outside the penalty area for one penalty stroke.
